column1: # Which checks a landing runs, by what it changes (package T4; tools/gate/scope.py names the groups and the checks each one stands for).
# Every row a changed file matches adds its groups: the run is the union over all changed files, whatever the order of the
# rows. A file that no row names makes the run `full`: everything the main gate runs today on the native game (the main
# level: every renderer's engine tests and 102-stop tour with pictures and replays, the other discs, the Android build and
# the tablet's short part). `**` is any folders, `*` stays in a name; a pattern with no `/` names a file anywhere.
# The mod suites (tests/mods, 546 tests on three renderers) and LumaLink's own check (380 tests) are in no group while the
# mods line below says off. The owner set all mod work aside until the native rewrite is done (11-20). `short` adds the
# quick mod set and LumaLink's check to the full run, `full` every mod suite; `gate.py --mods short|full` overrides it for
# one run, and `gate.py --main --mods full --only "mods/*,lumalink"` runs just those on demand. What stays whatever it says:
# the build makes both game modules (with and without the mod surface), and the test driver is itself a mod
# (tools/test_driver/luma_test/luma_test.c): every tour and replay loads it, so the mod engine's loading, hooks and calls
# by name are tested by them; a test driver that does not load is a FAIL.
